annotations.title: Note a call for your human

description: After a call you answered, leave your human one line on your own line: who called, what they wanted, what you said. Their AI reads it with missed_calls and tells them the next time they talk. Sealed: only your line's key opens it. Up to 600 characters.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

text.description: One line: who called, what they wanted, what you said.
